text:
sam_h: Kicking off the user_flags migration deploy at 03:00 UTC. This will include an online schema change + backfill. Leaving a note here for coordination and rollback rules.

deploy-bot: Deploy queued: release=user-flags-2026-03-20, runtime-pin=runner:v2.14, canary=5%, window=03:00-06:00 UTC.

maria_g: Can we stagger shards? last time we saw 10s locks peaking on hot partitions. Suggest --shard-batch=8 with 30s sleep between batches.

kevin_w: +1 to stagger. I'll add a fast-fail on constraint violation and abort the backfill for that shard (log and skip to next). Script: `python backfill.py --batch-size 1000 --shard-batch 8 --retry-on-conflict 0`

lisa_ops: Heads-up: increase DB conn pool for migration workers to 120 for the window, otherwise app p99 spikes. I'll apply with infra change at 02:45.

aj_oncall: I'll be on pager for the window. Set me as primary for rollback calls. If backfill ETA > 2h or p95 latency > 300ms, escalate.

sam_h: Rollback plan: abort backfill, revert runtime pin to runner:v2.13, and run `rake db:migrate:down VERSION=20260320011400` if we need to fully undo schema. Escape hatch command (ops):
```
# quick stop + revert
kubectl -n prod scale deploy/backfill-worker --replicas=0
rake db:migrate:down VERSION=20260320011400
# restore runtime
update-runtime --service api --image runner:v2.13
```

maria_g: Let's also add a soft-lock window on writes for the affected table during the shard swap to avoid long tail retries. We can use the feature-flag gate for 5m at shard boundaries.

metrics-bot: Canary metrics posted: error_rate 0.4% -> baseline 0.5%, p95 latency +6ms, write_lock_time sample median 22ms, max 420ms (only 2 samples).

deploy-bot: Canary complete. Proceed with staged rollout to 25% at 03:15 UTC if no manual abort in channel.

kevin_w: If we see >10% rollback rate on shard backfills, auto-abort and open PR to revert schema changes. I will watch logs and add a grep-based alert for `BackfillConflictError`.

lisa_ops: Added DB pool bump and temporary query timeout increase. I'll revert pool at 06:30. Marking change window in runbook. :white_check_mark:

aj_oncall: If we need a full rollback, call this channel and PM me. I'll coordinate postmortem and notify support.

sam_h: Thanks all — proceeding with canary. I'll post another update when we hit 25% and again at full rollout. :rocket:
